quests.instruction: Speak the opposite of the highlighted word.
quests.hint: Think of a news story being covered by TV channels around the world.
quests.explanation: International is correct — it means involving many different countries, the opposite of local.
quests.textToSpeak: We usually shop at the *local* market on Saturday mornings.

quests.instruction: Speak the opposite of the highlighted word.
quests.hint: It's an airport gate for a flight crossing several countries.
quests.explanation: Involving many different countries is international, the reverse of local.
quests.textToSpeak: Our school hosted a *local* science fair last spring.

quests.instruction: Speak the opposite of the highlighted word.
quests.hint: Picture a brand sold in dozens of countries, not just one town.
quests.explanation: Local means limited to one area; international, its opposite, means spanning many countries.
quests.textToSpeak: The company mainly serves *local* customers in this region.

quests.instruction: Speak the opposite of the highlighted word.
quests.hint: Imagine a no-frills hotel room with just a bed and a shower.
quests.explanation: Budget is right here — it means inexpensive, offering only basic features, the opposite of luxury.
quests.textToSpeak: They upgraded to a *luxury* hotel for their anniversary trip.

quests.instruction: Speak the opposite of the highlighted word.
quests.hint: That's a bare-bones flight ticket with no extras included.
quests.explanation: Right. Inexpensive, offering only the basics, is budget, the reverse of luxury.
quests.textToSpeak: Our family usually can't afford a *luxury* vacation every year.

quests.instruction: Speak the opposite of the highlighted word.
quests.hint: Consider the plainest, least expensive option on a menu.
quests.explanation: Luxury means high-end and expensive; budget, its opposite, means affordable and basic.
quests.textToSpeak: That brand is known for its *luxury* handbags.

quests.instruction: Speak the opposite of the highlighted word.
quests.hint: Envision a picnic spread out on a blanket in the park.
quests.explanation: Outdoor is correct — it means happening or used outside a building, the opposite of indoor.
quests.textToSpeak: The restaurant has a lovely *indoor* dining room with a fireplace.

quests.instruction: Speak the opposite of the highlighted word.
quests.hint: This is a hike along a trail with the sky wide open above you.
quests.explanation: Happening or used outside a building is outdoor, the reverse of indoor.
quests.textToSpeak: This camera isn't designed for *indoor* photography.

quests.instruction: Speak the opposite of the highlighted word.
quests.hint: Call to mind a garden concert with the stars overhead instead of a ceiling.
quests.explanation: Indoor means inside a building; outdoor, its opposite, means out in the open air.
quests.textToSpeak: *Indoor* air quality can affect how well you sleep.

quests.instruction: Speak the opposite of the highlighted word.
quests.hint: Think of collapsing onto the sofa after a full day of moving boxes.
quests.explanation: Exhausted is the word here — it means extremely tired, drained of energy, the opposite of energetic.
quests.textToSpeak: The dancers looked *energetic* throughout the entire show.

quests.instruction: Speak the opposite of the highlighted word.
quests.hint: It's how you'd feel after running a marathon with no training.
quests.explanation: Good job. Extremely tired, with no energy left, is exhausted, the reverse of energetic.
quests.textToSpeak: I feel *energetic* after a good night's sleep.

quests.instruction: Speak the opposite of the highlighted word.
quests.hint: Picture barely being able to keep your eyes open after a sleepless night.
quests.explanation: Energetic means full of energy; exhausted, its opposite, means completely drained of it.
quests.textToSpeak: The kids were still *energetic* even after a full day of classes.

quests.instruction: Speak the opposite of the highlighted word.
quests.hint: Imagine plain rice with no seasoning at all.
quests.explanation: Exactly — mild. It means having very little strong flavor or heat, the opposite of spicy.
quests.textToSpeak: Someone brought *spicy* wings to the office party.

quests.instruction: Speak the opposite of the highlighted word.
quests.hint: That's a sauce so gentle you could feed it to a young child.
quests.explanation: Having very little strong flavor or heat is mild, the reverse of spicy.
quests.textToSpeak: The street food in that city was famously *spicy*.

quests.instruction: Speak the opposite of the highlighted word.
quests.hint: Consider soup with barely a hint of any spice.
quests.explanation: Spicy means packed with heat and strong flavor; mild, its opposite, means gentle on the tongue.
quests.textToSpeak: My grandmother's curry is always deliciously *spicy*.

quests.instruction: Speak the opposite of the highlighted word.
quests.hint: Envision a lecture so slow that half the room is checking the clock.
quests.explanation: Boring is right here — it means not interesting, causing no excitement, the opposite of exciting.
quests.textToSpeak: The Black Friday sale felt *exciting* with so many discounts.

quests.instruction: Speak the opposite of the highlighted word.
quests.hint: This is a movie with nothing happening for two straight hours.
quests.explanation: Not interesting, causing no excitement, is boring, the reverse of exciting.
quests.textToSpeak: Trying street food in a new country is always *exciting*.

quests.instruction: Speak the opposite of the highlighted word.
quests.hint: Call to mind a meeting that drags on with no new information at all.
quests.explanation: Exciting means thrilling and engaging; boring, its opposite, means dull and uneventful.
quests.textToSpeak: The keynote announcement was genuinely *exciting* for developers.

quests.instruction: Speak the opposite of the highlighted word.
quests.hint: Think of rushing through five errands with only twenty minutes to spare.
quests.explanation: Stressful is correct — it means causing worry, tension, or pressure, the opposite of relaxing.
quests.textToSpeak: A short walk after dinner can be very *relaxing*.

quests.instruction: Speak the opposite of the highlighted word.
quests.hint: It's a deadline that keeps getting closer while nothing is finished.
quests.explanation: Terrific. Causing worry, tension, or pressure is stressful, the reverse of relaxing.
quests.textToSpeak: Watching a slow, quiet film can feel *relaxing* after a long week.

quests.instruction: Speak the opposite of the highlighted word.
quests.hint: Picture a delayed flight with a connection you're about to miss.
quests.explanation: Relaxing means calming and easy; stressful, its opposite, means tense and demanding.
quests.textToSpeak: Sunday mornings are the most *relaxing* part of my week.

quests.instruction: Speak the opposite of the highlighted word.
quests.hint: Imagine a decision that made almost everyone in the office unhappy.
quests.explanation: Unpopular is the word here — it means not well liked by most people, the opposite of popular.
quests.textToSpeak: That teacher is *popular* because her classes are so much fun.

quests.instruction: Speak the opposite of the highlighted word.
quests.hint: That's a restaurant that always seems to have empty tables.
quests.explanation: Not well liked by most people is unpopular, the reverse of popular.
quests.textToSpeak: The new schedule turned out to be *popular* with most employees.

quests.instruction: Speak the opposite of the highlighted word.
quests.hint: Consider a policy that most people openly complain about.
quests.explanation: Popular means liked by many; unpopular, its opposite, means disliked by most.
quests.textToSpeak: This beach town is *popular* with tourists every summer.

quests.instruction: Speak the opposite of the highlighted word.
quests.hint: Envision someone attempting a task for the very first time, with no training.
quests.explanation: That's it — unskilled. It means lacking training or experience, the opposite of skilled.
quests.textToSpeak: My father is a *skilled* carpenter who built our kitchen table.

quests.instruction: Speak the opposite of the highlighted word.
quests.hint: This is a worker who's never been taught how to do the job properly.
quests.explanation: Well spotted. Lacking training or experience in a task is unskilled, the reverse of skilled.
quests.textToSpeak: The tailor is *skilled* enough to fix almost any piece of clothing.

quests.instruction: Speak the opposite of the highlighted word.
quests.hint: Call to mind someone struggling to use tools they've never touched before.
quests.explanation: Skilled means trained and experienced; unskilled, its opposite, means lacking that training.
quests.textToSpeak: It takes a *skilled* chef to make sushi look that precise.

quests.instruction: Speak the opposite of the highlighted word.
quests.hint: Think of an artist whose work nobody has ever heard of.
quests.explanation: Unknown is right here — it means not known or recognized by many people, the opposite of famous.
quests.textToSpeak: That app was created by a *famous* engineer from a major tech company.

quests.instruction: Speak the opposite of the highlighted word.
quests.hint: It's a small local band that's never played outside their hometown.
quests.explanation: Not known or recognized by many people is unknown, the reverse of famous.
quests.textToSpeak: The clinic was founded by a *famous* heart surgeon.

quests.instruction: Speak the opposite of the highlighted word.
quests.hint: Picture a scientist whose discovery never made it into the news.
quests.explanation: Famous means widely recognized; unknown, its opposite, means recognized by hardly anyone.
quests.textToSpeak: She became *famous* after her first movie became a huge hit.
